event_time_policy.maturity: retention cohorts are counted only after the full D1/D7/D30 window

journey_reliability.definition: successful Product Journey Outcome divided by Product Journey Started attempts
journey_reliability.policy: Recording Completed alone proves neither server persistence nor usable content; native batch observation gaps are unknown

journey_pending_rate.definition: started attempts younger than one hour without an observed outcome

journey_unknown_rate.definition: started attempts older than one hour without an outcome, or explicitly unobserved

time_to_first_result_ms.definition: event-time latency from Product Journey Started to Product Journey First Result

activation_rate.definition: signed-up users with a Product Value event

time_to_value_seconds.definition: event-time latency from signup to first Product Value

retention_d1_d7_d30.definition: mature signup cohorts with Product Value in the closed [signup+n, signup+n+1) event-time window

helpfulness_exposure_response_rate.definition: users submitting feedback divided by users exposed to a feedback prompt

helpfulness_rate.definition: helpful feedback submissions divided by all feedback submissions

paid_churn_rate.definition: authoritative Billing Subscription Churned users after the selected start-of-window Billing Paid Population Snapshot divided by that snapshot's paid users; scheduled cancellation lifecycle events are excluded while an ended subscription remains churn
paid_churn_rate.policy: missing start-of-window snapshot is insufficient evidence; subscription-start events cannot manufacture the denominator

error_affected_user_rate.definition: active users with Product Error divided by active users

capture_observed_expected_ratio.definition: observed audio/transcription duration divided by expected capture duration

telemetry_health_observations.definition: count of explicit Mobile Telemetry Health observations, with dropped and handoff failure sums
telemetry_health_observations.policy: absence is insufficient evidence; this does not prove backend delivery

render_slow_frame_rate.definition: frames over the fixed 32ms threshold divided by observed frame summaries
render_slow_frame_rate.policy: render timing only; no inference about network readiness, native hangs, battery, or usefulness

render_first_frame_ms.definition: mean duration to the first post-frame callback for bounded named surfaces

capture_audio_observation_rate.definition: recording sessions with an explicit audio observation divided by recording sessions that emitted Recording Started

capture_transcript_observation_rate.definition: recording sessions with an explicit transcript observation divided by recording sessions that emitted Recording Started

recording_conversation_linkage.definition: recording sessions with an explicit conversation_id/object_id join divided by recording sessions observed
recording_conversation_linkage.policy: timestamp proximity never establishes a join

cost_usd.definition: sum of explicitly attributed cost_usd properties; absent cost is insufficient evidence
